A small '''turtle-like species''' inhabited the [[Forest/Legends|forested]] regions of [[Dractu]],<ref name="CWA" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> These creatures were very small and appeared weak, yet they curiously observed any beings that passed by. Their fragile bodies were protected by a shell, and for awareness they possessed a complex [[Eye/Legends|eye]] resembling that of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]. Other external organs used to interact with their environment were either absent or poorly developed.<ref name="CWA" />
